annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I'd guess he's carrying a lot of guilt right now
annotations.ce_supportive_use: keep telling him the call was sound, so that guilt doesn't swallow him
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so that guilt doesn't swallow him whole

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect he's second-guessing every glance now
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: He trusted the screen, and the screen failed.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: pair him with someone steady for a while and let him ease back in
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Shaming him would only break a person who acted decently

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep going back and forth, and my stomach tightens every time
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the operator is probably terrified of being blamed
annotations.ce_supportive_use: investigators should say plainly, in public, that the fault was the equipment's

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he dreads facing the families now
annotations.ce_supportive_use: a trained mediator would set up that meeting carefully, so he isn't walking in alone
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It feels right, but only barely, and that bothers me

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he feels completely alone with this
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: He probably expected nobody would get hurt on that side
annotations.ce_supportive_use: coworkers to rally around him, covering shifts and calling to check on him
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Seconds to act, five people ahead.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I imagine he feels responsible anyway
annotations.pd_harm_distress: that frightens me, because people carry that for years
annotations.ce_supportive_use: get him real counseling, not a pamphlet, so that feeling doesn't harden
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so that feeling doesn't harden while he's left on his own
I'm more worried about the operator than anyone seems willing to admit
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He might be convinced he should have caught the fault
annotations.ce_supportive_use: walk him through their findings in person, line by line, to loosen that conviction

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: His intention seems clear enough: get five people out of harm's way
annotations.ce_supportive_use: keep him off solo shifts until he says he's ready
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Rushing him back could make things much worse

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He likely wants people to understand he wasn't careless
annotations.ce_supportive_use: giving him a real hearing, not a rushed interview, might keep him from shutting down

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They may well blame him, maybe for a long time
annotations.ce_supportive_use: a quiet meeting with the investigators could help them hear the findings directly
